init_base_gpt_model: initialize a BaseGPTModel instance with an OpenAI or Azure client and model name
sample_text_gpt: sample text completion from a GPT model using the sample_text method with a prompt
sample_choice_gpt: sample a multiple choice answer from a GPT model using the sample_choice method
sample_text_with_reasoning: sample text with configurable reasoning effort and verbosity using the internal _sample_text method
configure_gpt_verbosity: configure verbosity level for GPT-4o models by setting medium verbosity in the model name
